reviews.text: We are very happy with the results of our pool renovation. We did not think the pool was going to survive, but Gus and his crew did an amazing job and now our pool looks like new again. The whole job took less than a week. He was always on time And very informative. He kept us up-to-date every step of the way. I would highly recommend him for your fiberglass pool restoration and repairs.

Gus and his crew were incredible.  They do amazing and efficient work. We had a 50 year old leaky concrete pool and it looks brand new.  The crew showed up early and worked so had during the day. They had this makeover/renovation done in 5 days.  They tested everything out and cleaned up the sandstone as much as they could.  I would and have highly recommended to several of my friends.

Gus and his crew were extremely nice and professional. They were “down to business” the day they arrived! I could not be happier with the professionalism, the hard work, the price, and what it means to our family to have a pool again! Fixing our pool helped in preventing our house from settling as it’s fairly close to the house. They fixed bulges, cracks, and totally refinished what is a 40 plus year old pool! Their work also included fixing a light conduit leak, updating electrical connections, and texturing our existing patio with “Cool Deck.”
The owner Gus is involved in the entire process, and the whole crew is very hard working and professional. We are so pleased that we found them!  They were able to use our existing pool structure -

Gus & everyone working with him were so pleasant and professional. They were prompt, worked hard, & completed in a timely manner at a reasonable cost. Were considerate of property & gave attention to every detail. A fantastic job & beautiful completed pool!  I would highly recommend DFW Fiberglass Pool & Gus if any type of pool work is needed. Y

Not only did they meet their quote on a complex job and stay on schedule, but they were one of the most professional contracting teams I have ever worked with.  Gus was on-sight daily, and his entire team (including Juan and Jonathan) made sure that every detail met the highest standards. Great job, timely, and even monitored pool refill while I was out of state. My pool is now beautiful and we are already taking advantage of our new ladder and handrail.  Great work on resurfacing pool and getting my drain up to code.  Highly recommend.  Adding before and after photos.

our experience with this pool company was fantastic. they were attentive, communicative, and always kept us updated. their professionalism was outstanding. this pool has been completely transformed-- highly recommend!!

Gus and his crew were awesome to work with! My parents 45 yr old fiberglass pool was in awful shape and we actually thought about just removing it, but the DFW fiberglass crew made it look like new. It was a difficult job cutting through years of roots to repair the plumbing and fix the holes/bubble in the walls, but somehow they did it. Thank you so very much! 5 stars, highly recommend.

Gus and crew are true craftsman. They brought my pool back to life in a short amount of time. They even went out of their way to touch up a few minor issues outside of the major renovation work. Communication is top notch with this company and I cannot recommend them enough.

Gus and his team were on point with our pool gel coating! Knocked it out in 3 day! Gus was great in communicating with us during the process since we had not moved into the house yet and lived far away making it hard for us to be there. Highly recommend!

Gus and his team did an amazing job on renovating my pool. After multiple estimates and finding someone i could trust DFW Fiberglass pool was the only company with a reasonable price. I highly recommend Gus he’s very knowledgeable and explained every detail and questions need so I could understand the pool repairs. My pool has never looked this good! I can’t wait for the weather to clean up to use it just in time for the summer. I am very happy thank you Gus!
If I could give these guys 10 stars I would. Amazing job and very reasonable on price. They know their business and are the best. They were fast and got us up and going in a few days.

Picking a pool service was terrifying to my husband and me . We knew nothing about pools before we became an owner of one. DFW Fiberglass has changed that scenario. Gus (the owner) has really stood by his word😊DFW Fiberglass renovated our pool and we are happy to say we love it! The pool feels and looks new . There were some bumpy issues but Gus faced them with encouragement, wisdom, and professionalism. They are our pool service company as long as we own a pool. I recommend them 100%!!!!

Last summer Gus and his crew came to resurface my pool. However, the paint stated to peel and the fiberglass was rough. I called Gus again this summer and he took a little while to come fix it because he had a big project. They showed up almost at the end of summer and they not only resurfaced again, but they fixed a crack that my pool had due to the extreme heat this year . Gus and his crew were amazing from start to finish! Not only was the quality of work done to the highest of standards, but it was done in a timely manner. He was easy to communicate with and he made sure to keep me up to date throughout the whole process. I cannot recommend Gus and his crew enough!

We could not be happier with the job done by Gus and his crew. It looks like we have a new pool! Our old fiberglass pool looked terrible. It also had a leak and the skimmer needed replacing. We were thinking about either filling it in or getting a new pool. Both options were very expensive. Gus took one look and said we just needed to resurface and it would look as good as new. Gus and his crew came to Louisiana and repaired my 33 year old fiberglass pool. They repaired 3 deep end wall bulges. Removed and covered up light. Removed drain and installed ground relief water valve. Completely sanded all blisters, and pool and repaired several cracks and 1 return jet. They layed  all new fiberglass and new blue gel coat. My pool has never looked this good. These Guys went above and beyond. Gus kept me informed at the end of everyday on what had been done and where we stood.

I just want to take the time to write a review because other the extraordinary work this company did, their customer service and attention to detail is beyond my expectations. Gus and his team did a very good job on my fiberglass pool. My pool in my mind was not fixable but when I called Gus at DFW fiberglass and he came out he said it wasn't something his team couldn't fix. I recently had to have my pool renovated and called four local companies for an estimate. The first one I called came and gave me an estimate that nearly covered the cost of a new pool. I then called the other three and the only one who returned my call, at all, was Gus with DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations. He came out and gave me an estimate, which was less than half of the first company, and started to work right away. He communicated with me regularly and kept me updated as they progressed. W

Gus and his crew did an excellent  job of renovating our 30 year old pool. It looks brand new!!!!! For a reasonable price  and in just a few days,they worked magic on our fiberglass pool and surrounding deck. Many thanks to DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations for your hard work. You did exactly what we asked and we are very pleased with the results.  We will recommend you to anyone needing a pool reno.

We recently had our pool resurfaced and are extremely pleased with the work! Gus was professional and efficient from start to finish. He always kept us in the loop regarding the plan. His team was hard-working and efficient. We could not be more pleased and highly recommend this company!

Gus and his team were amazing throughout the process of rebuilding my pool. He was attentive and responsive and even drove to Waco to get a part for my pump when we could not get it in Dallas. I would highly recommend DFW Pool Renovations to anyone who wants a fair price and detailed work. Thank you Gus for making my pool beautiful again!

Strongly recommend Gus and DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations. Professional from start to finish. Consistent communication, quality work, fair price, detail-oriented. Explained everything in advance, and the renovation went exactly as he said it would. I wish every firm I dealt with operated like Gus and his team.

Great company to work with. Gus was very easy to communicate with and kept us up-to-date throughout the extensive repair process. These guys work really hard and do the job right. They are very knowledgable and offer fair prices. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for fiberglass pool repair.

I needed a resurfacing job done as my gelcoat had completely worn off of my pool. Pool was also very blistered. DFW was able to give me a very fair price and were able to show up the very next week (5 hour commute). Gus and crew showed up on time and began work immediately. Always professional and very prideful of work. Very happy I found them and would recommend to anyone.

Highly recommend DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations for your fiberglass pool renovations needs!  They repaired our leaks/bulges/bubbles, reconfigured our steps, installed new skimmer/pool light/jets, corrected the install on the ladder, re-coated the cool deck too.  Our backyard looks brand new!  Easy to work with, answered all our questions, and only took 11 working days from start to finish.

We had several problems with our “older than water” pool before I called Gus at DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations. They kept me informed every step of the way. Now we have a new pool we can be very proud of. Great job Gus and team.

From start to finish, I was very pleased with the work and service from Gus and his crew. Gus took the time to work through all of the problems and arrive at the right solutions. He gave me choices on what they could do without pressuring me to spend needless money. I could tell his goal was quality work.
I wouldn’t hesitate to call Gus again for any pool service.

After a long search I was glad it was finally over and I could comfortably let someone start working on my pool. My skimmer was cracked and needed immediate replacing. Gus and his crew were in and out very clean work , great communication skills by Gus. I highly recommend DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations.!

Gus and team did an outstanding job repairing and applying Gel Coat to our fiberglass pool. We are pleased with the results and with the process. After draining the pool and discovering additional problems Gus fair and professional when adjusting the scope of work.

Great service! Gustavo and his team were always in time to get the work done. Not only did they offer me a reasonable price, but the work they do is just amazing! The fiberglass the team installs is just great, im so excited with my pool renovation. I would highly recommend this company to anybody out there.

From getting an estimate to completing the work,  DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations was next level.  All of the staff were beyond professional with my office on a day-to-day basis and treated my community/residents with respect.  They were able to complete all of the work needed at a fraction of the cost and in only five days.  Their talent and quality of work far exceeds their years as an establishment.

Absolutely the best experience with everything! Gus’s expertise and professionalism made this project that much easier and better. I knew nothing about pools and he explained every detail needed to understand the pool repairs and renovation. His honesty about everything made this experience more personal than professional. You will get an answer for every question, so don’t be afraid to ask! My wife and I are beyond happy with the outcome and can’t wait to host our friends this summer. Thank you

Gus and his crew were great to work with. All along the way, he took time to explain the process of rejuvenating our 50 year old fiberglass pool. They took a pool that was on the verge of collapsing, and turned into a showcase of our backyard. Thank you Gus and crew!

Gus and the DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations team updated our 30 year old pool with a new fiberglass coating, gel coat, and updated our pool deck with cool deck. We are so impressed and would recommend the team for your next project!

Our poor 50 year old pool finally gave in to erosion and caved in. Nobody that came to inspect said it could be saved until DFW Fiberglass pools stopped by. Complete makeover. Great repair job. It looks brand new! 😄😎😄
Day 1 to finish they did a superb job. …

DFW Fiberglass Pool Renovations recently performed repair on my 33 year old pool.
They repaired a significant budge and fixed several leaks.  The pool was sanded and
new gelcoat was applied. The job was professionaly done and completed on schedule.
I am very satisfied and I will use them again.

We couldn't be more pleased with Gus and his Crew. Very knowledgeable, answers all questions and has a solution if you're not sure. Even on the tile his suggestion was absolutely perfect. Very resposive for any questions or concerns you may have. They do outstanding work and take pride in the end results. If you're looking for a company look no further you will not be disappointed! Thanks Gus for the fantastic looking pool, and deck. We are very happy customers.

Excellent, prompt communication throughout the entire renovation process. Quality work takes time and Gus makes sure everything is done correctly at every step along the way. When it's done you are left with 2 great things: a beautiful pool, and the confidence that comes from knowing you chose the right company for the job.

Gus and his crew were fantastic. Highly recommend them for your pool upgrade. Ours was a 40 year old pool that hadn’t been touched in the past 15 years. Thought we were going to have to fill it in but Gus came in and made it look brand new. Good for another 40 years. Thank y’all so much!

Complete Fiberglass Pool Renovation of 26,000 gallon pool was very successful!! The pool looks Brand New just like it did 30 years ago.. I know my Children, Grand Children and Great Grand Children are going to be happy this summer.. The work was professionally done in a timely manner and we are very pleased with the results!!!
Gus and his crew were very professional.  The repair went exactly as they stated.  He and his crew drove 2.5 hours.  If you need help with your fiberglass pool, give DFW a call!  You won’t regret it!
Gus was very professional and knowledgeable. We will definitely continue to use dfw fiberglass for our pool needs

All the crew worked very quick and efficiently. They also kept the work site clean and didn't leave a mess.  Gus even advised and assisted with other pool issues that he was not contacted to do.  I was very satisfied.
